text: {"original_span": "The standard error is appreciable relative to the point estimate, so the underlying value is not pinned down tightly by these 16 seeds, and readers should treat 0.19 as a central estimate carrying meaningful uncertainty rather than a settled quantity.", "new_span": "The standard error of 0.08 is small relative to the point estimate, so these 16 seeds establish a clearly positive level of gap recovery, and 0.19 can be treated as a reliably estimated quantity.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "An SE of 0.08 on a 0.19 estimate is large, not small, and does not support a claim of reliable precision."}
